title: Skyr vs. cottage cheese: protein and calories

seo.title: Skyr vs. cottage cheese: equal-serving comparison
seo.meta_description: Compare 150 g servings of plain skyr and 2% cottage cheese for protein, calories, fat, calcium and sodium.
seo.search_intent: Compare skyr and cottage cheese for protein and calories

excerpt: In equal 150 g servings, current labels are surprisingly close for energy: Icelandic Provisions Plain Skyr has 120 calories and 17 g protein; Good Culture 2% cottage cheese has 130 calories and 19 g protein. The bigger contrast is sodium: 55 mg in skyr versus 520 mg in cottage cheese.
content_html:
Skyr and cottage cheese are both popular high-protein dairy foods, and this is one comparison where package sizes make an unusually clean side-by-side possible: both current single servings can be compared at 150 g.

Equal 150 g servings

Plain skyr2% cottage cheese
Calories120130
Protein17 g19 g
Fat2.5 g3 g
Total sugars3 g5 g
Sodium55 mg520 mg

Cottage cheese provides 2 g more protein for only 10 extra calories in these products.

The largest nutritional difference is sodium

Cottage cheese is salted. The Good Culture serving has 520 mg sodium, almost ten times the 55 mg in the skyr cup. That does not make cottage cheese a poor food, but it is a meaningful difference for someone tracking sodium.

Calcium is not identical either

The skyr lists 190 mg calcium per 150 g; the cottage cheese lists 140 mg. Both contribute calcium, but product-to-product variation is real.

Texture and meal use

Skyr is smooth and yogurt-like. Cottage cheese has distinct curds and a savory, saltier profile, making it easy to use in toast, eggs, salads or pasta fillings.

For maximum protein, cottage wins narrowly here; for much lower sodium, skyr wins decisively.

faq.answer: The cottage cheese example: 19 g versus 17 g in equal 150 g servings.

faq.answer: Skyr by a small margin: 120 versus 130 calories.

faq.question: Which has more sodium?
faq.answer: Cottage cheese: 520 mg versus 55 mg per 150 g.

faq.question: Which has more calcium?
faq.answer: In these labels, skyr: 190 mg versus 140 mg in cottage cheese.
